killedBy: capture.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute (issue #841) retries a refused screenshot at BOTH levels, because they rescue different states
why: Leaves `screen.startup.unsupported-render` with no evidence on the CI runner. That state photographs a page whose WebGL context was refused, and `Page.captureScreenshot` is refused for it whenever a state that ran a live match preceded it through the same browser -- ten of the other forty-four do. Retrying the screenshot CALL is not enough for this one: measured on Linux across the real sequence, the in-page retry rescues `probe-blocked` and leaves this state still failing, and only repeating the capture on a fresh page brings it back. The failure is silent in the worst way, because the state still PASSES on its measurements; all that is lost is the picture a reader needs when it one day fails for a real reason.
